jobs.description: Hi I’m Abhik , Ashby 's Co-Founder and VP of Engineering. I want folks like me to feel at home at Ashby, and so I made Design Engineering a formal role and department that works closely with me. Our first hire was over five years ago, and we’re doubling the team from five to over ten in the next year. This role truly expects you to design and code. Design Engineer at Ashby isn’t just a Frontend Engineer with new branding, nor is it a Designer vibe coding prototypes. Combining excellence in both is where magic happens. I found that when I put my best effort into both the design and technical implementation of a feature, I had a nimbleness and creativity that was hard to achieve when I did only one or the other. For instance, the UX and UI I envisioned often influenced the data model's design and flexibility, while the understanding of technology's capabilities often simplified or improved the design. This role embraces that. You’ll work on our most challenging design problems, help others improve their designs by expanding and enhancing our in-house design system, and consult on bespoke design work needed by Product Engineers. jobs.title: Design Engineer - UK
jobs.description: Hi I’m Abhik , Ashby 's Co-Founder and VP of Engineering. This role is close to my heart because, as someone who can both design and code, it’s where I’ve always done my best work, but also where I was seen as a rebel and an outsider. I want folks like me to feel at home at Ashby, and so I made Design Engineering a formal role and department that works closely with me. Our first hire was over five years ago, and we’re doubling the team from five to over ten in the next year. This role truly expects you to design and code. Design Engineer at Ashby isn’t just a Frontend Engineer with new branding, nor is it a Designer vibe coding prototypes. Combining excellence in both is where magic happens. I found that when I put my best effort into both the design and technical implementation of a feature, I had a nimbleness and creativity that was hard to achieve when I did only one or the other. For instance, the UX and UI I envisioned often influenced the data model's design and flexibility, while the understanding of technology's capabilities often simplified or improved the design. This role embraces that. You’ll work on our most challenging design problems, help others improve their designs by expanding and enhancing our in-house design system, and consult on bespoke design work needed by Product Engineers. To ground it with examples, Design Engineers at Ashby have: Redesigned our mobile web app by talking with customers who use it often, wireframing new flows, implementing its design system, and using that system to turn the wireframes into a polished UI. Built a set of flexible, composable components in our design system that allow other engineers to build beautiful, consistent setup wizards across our product easily. Helped a Product Engineer improve the information hierarchy and scannability of their design for viewing a candidate’s assessments. Recruiters can quickly parse information and pick out anomalies. jobs.description: At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors. Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Kpler is expanding into high-value maritime verticals, with Cruise Liners and Port Operations representing two important opportunities. In the cruise sector, operators and analysts often rely on published itineraries rather than actual vessel movements, despite the significant fuel and carbon costs associated with fleet operations. In ports, performance data is often incomplete or self-reported, creating a need for independent benchmarking as berth-level emissions carry increasing financial implications under schemes such as the EU ETS. Working closely with the Lead Product Manager – Maritime & Logistics, you will build two early-stage products in parallel, leveraging Kpler’s network of more than 13,000 AIS receivers and over 10,000 mapped ports and berths. Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l'art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture. Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l'appartement parisien d'Auguste Perret (La Croisière). Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d'ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street). jobs.description: About GiveDirectly What if the most effective way to fight poverty was also the simplest: give people money and trust them to decide what they need? Since 2011, GiveDirectly has proven that idea at scale. We’ve delivered more than $1B in cash directly to 2+ million people living in poverty and crisis across 15 countries, and rigorous research shows the results: healthier kids, stronger businesses, sturdier homes, and more resilient families and local economies. Cash is now widely recognized as one of the most scalable, cost-effective, and dignified forms of aid. Our ambition goes beyond our own programs. We want cash to become the benchmark for aid, much as the index fund became the benchmark for investing, so that every aid dollar is held to one question: is this doing more good than giving the money directly to people living in poverty? We’re growing fast, and this is a rare and important moment to join. We expect to hit $1B in revenue in 2026 with significant growth forecast for 2027. At the same time we are building a new technology stack and operating model designed for a roughly 10x change in scale, and we are actively pursuing partnerships with major funders to move even more money in bigger ways, to people who need it. We are known for our extensive integration of technology into field processes; our quantitative approach to performance measurement; and our commitment to rigorous, independent, experimental evaluation of our impact, with multiple Randomized Control Trials completed and others in progress. How we work Our team spans 20+ countries and 69 languages. Our culture is candid, analytical, and non-hierarchical. We expect high ownership and give people real responsibility early. Our values are central to how we hire, work, and grow, and they are deliberately opinionated: Recipients first. Recipients’ preferences come before those of donors or ourselves. Team next. jobs.title: Design Engineer - Canada
jobs.description: Hi I’m Abhik , Ashby 's Co-Founder and VP of Engineering. This role is close to my heart because, as someone who can both design and code, it’s where I’ve always done my best work, but also where I was seen as a rebel and an outsider. I want folks like me to feel at home at Ashby, and so I made Design Engineering a formal role and department that works closely with me. Our first hire was over five years ago, and we’re doubling the team from five to over ten in the next year. This role truly expects you to design and code. Design Engineer at Ashby isn’t just a Frontend Engineer with new branding, nor is it a Designer vibe coding prototypes. Combining excellence in both is where magic happens. I found that when I put my best effort into both the design and technical implementation of a feature, I had a nimbleness and creativity that was hard to achieve when I did only one or the other. For instance, the UX and UI I envisioned often influenced the data model's design and flexibility, while the understanding of technology's capabilities often simplified or improved the design. This role embraces that. You’ll work on our most challenging design problems, help others improve their designs by expanding and enhancing our in-house design system, and consult on bespoke design work needed by Product Engineers. To ground it with examples, Design Engineers at Ashby have: Redesigned our mobile web app by talking with customers who use it often, wireframing new flows, implementing its design system, and using that system to turn the wireframes into a polished UI. Built a set of flexible, composable components in our design system that allow other engineers to build beautiful, consistent setup wizards across our product easily. Helped a Product Engineer improve the information hierarchy and scannability of their design for viewing a candidate’s assessments. Recruiters can quickly parse information and pick out anomalies. Tu rejoindras une équipe à taille humaine, composée d ingénieurs passionnés. Nous sommes fans de développement logiciel, d Infrastructure as Code, de culture DevOps/SRE, d automatisation, de veille technologique... et bien sûr, de sport ! Périmètre et missions d un Platform Engineer En tant que Platform Engineer , tu joueras un rôle central dans l autonomisation des équipes de développement grâce à l ingénierie de plateforme. Tes missions s articuleront autour des piliers suivants : 1. Ingénierie Logicielle & Abstraction Cloud Utiliser les meilleures pratiques de développement (Software Engineering, Software Architecture) pour concevoir du code propre, robuste et maintenable créant des couches d abstraction au-dessus du Cloud. Développer et industrialiser des API, outils internes et modules d infrastructure en Python et Go. Consommer et orchestrer des services Serverless (Google Cloud Functions, Google Workflows) et moderniser l outillage de déploiement. 2. Infrastructure as Code & Automatisation DevSecOps Concevoir, tester et déployer l infrastructure de manière cohérente et automatisée avec Terraform. Construire et optimiser des pipelines CI/CD modernes (de préférence avec GitHub Actions) intégrant les standards de sécu

jobs.description: Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI. What Is The Role: We are on the lookout for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Elasticsearch - Distributed Systems team and focus on how Elasticsearch provides scale, performance, and resilience, especially in the context of our Serverless offering. You will be tackling deep distributed systems challenges in how nodes in an Elasticsearch cluster communicate, and how data are indexed, allocated, and managed across nodes. What You Will Be Doing: Leveraging your distributed systems expertise to build, and operate core pieces of our next-generation Serverless Elasticsearch offering, directly impacting the experience of customers worldwide. Improving Elasticsearch’s components that support concurrent and consistent indexing across multiple machines. Wir sehen die tiefgreifenden Auswirkungen, die unsere Graphen-Lösungen auf die Umgestaltung der Branche habenwerden. Wir laden dich ein, mit uns gemeinsam den Wandel voranzutreiben, indem wir kluge Köpfe mit einer gemeinsamen Vision zusammenbringen. Die Vision lautet: Beweise allen, dass du etwas grundlegend verändern kannst. Beweise mit deinem Wissen und deinen Fähigkeiten, wie Dinge anders gemacht werden können. Gemeinsam können wir das Paradigma, wie die Welt zusammenhängt, verändern. Unsere Technologie Die wachsende Nachfrage der Halbleiterindustrie nach leistungsfähigeren Chips mit höherer Bandbreite und geringerem Stromverbrauch findet ihre Lösung in unserer Technologie. Wir verbinden Chips mit Computernetzwerken mit hohem Durchsatz und geringer Verzögerung. Der Schlüssel liegt in der Nutzung der physikalischen Eigenschaften von Graphen, um elektronische Datenverarbeitung mit photonischer Kommunikation zu verbinden, so dass zahllose Chips miteinander interagieren können, als wären sie ein einziger. Unsere Graphen-Photonik-Innovation steigert die Rechenleistung und Effizienz in einer neuen Größenordnung. Kurz gesagt , wir verbinden Chips zu leistungsstarken und energieeffizienten Netzwerken und überwinden so die Grenzen der Konnektivität in der Halbleiterindustrie mittels Graphen. Deine Rolle In dieser Position verantwortest du die strategische Beschaffung und das Lieferantenmanagement für Materialien, die für die Fertigung von Halbleitern unverzichtbar sind. Dabei berücksichtigst du sowohl die sich stets weiterentwickelnden technologischen Anforderungen als auch die Veränderungen der Marktbedingungen. jobs.description: PT Patra Drilling Contractor (PDC) adalah perusahaan yang bergerak pada bidang jasa penunjang dalam industri energi di Indonesia. PDC (selanjutnya disebut sebagai Perseroan) didirikan pada 11 September 1981 sebagai perusahaan nasional pertama yang fokus menyediakan layanan pengeboran lepas pantai di Indonesia sebagai prioritas pertama. Setelah 38 tahun berkontribusi dalam penyediaan energi nasional, Perseroan semakin memantapkan langkahnya menjadi perusahaan jasa penunjang industri energi terdepan yang mengutamakan keseimbangan antara aspek people dan , profit dan planet. Hal tersebut dibuktikan dengan pertumbuhan kinerja Perseroan secara eksponensial yang diiringi dengan penguatan pada aspek sosial dan lingkungan. Langkah nyata yang dilakukan Perseroan yaitu dengan memperkuat tata kelola keberlanjutan terutama di bidang kesehatan, keselamatan, keamanan dan pelestarian lingkungan serta mendorong pemerataan kesejahteraan sosial di masyarakat sekitar proyek. Laporan Keberlanjutan Tahun 2019 dikembangkan dengan tema: Mengutamakan Keberlanjutan sebagai Cara untuk Terus Bertumbuh. Lowongan Kerja PT Patra Drilling Contractor (PDC) Saat ini PT Patra Drilling Contractor (PDC) memberikan kesempatan lowongan kerja untuk dapat bergabung bersama dengan posisi sebagai berikut: Associate Contract Service Acceptance Uraian Tugas: Menyiapkan, mengumpulkan, dan memverifikasi dokumen administrasi, serta dokumen pendukung penagihan; Melakukan monitoring aging dan progress invoice, serta follow-up kepada customer; Melakukan koordinasi dan komunikasi dengan customer, user, vendor, dan stakeholder terkait; Memastikan kesesuaian invoice dengan realisasi pekerjaan dan dokumen pendukung; Menyusun dan melakukan monitoring estimasi nilai pekerjaan bulanan (accrual); Melakukan update dan monitoring data revenu

jobs.description: About the Role  Within Global Customer Experience (GCX), our mission is to advance the HelloFresh customer relationship from reactive resolution to proactive, trust-building service. The compensation function sits at the heart of that mission: it is the mechanism through which the business acknowledges failures, restores customer confidence, and, when done well, turns a bad experience into a reason to stay. The Associate Director, Customer Compensation & Policy is responsible for the global strategy, architecture, and governance of how HelloFresh compensates customers across all markets and brands. This is not a policy maintenance role. It is a strategic function that sits at the intersection of customer economics, operational data, behavioral experimentation, and cross-functional influence. You will own one of the most financially material and customer-sensitive levers in the business. You will shape a multi-year roadmap and hold peers in Operations, Technology, Finance, and Market Leadership accountable for the quality of inputs that determine how well and how efficiently we recover customer trust. The ideal candidate brings a rare combination: analytical rigor sharp enough to architect a global compensation engine from first principles, and the executive presence to drive adoption across a complex, multi-market organization without formal authority over most of the people they need to move. Working across multiple clients and markets, you'll need strong stakeholder management, prioritisation and communication skills. We're looking for a highly organised, proactive self-starter who can build trust, create clarity from complexity and drive progress in a fast-moving environment. Experience of flexibility markets is highly advantageous. However, we also welcome exceptional candidates who can demonstrate strong stakeholder management, commercial awareness and an ability to drive outcomes in complex environments. The role offers an opportunity to work with some of the most innovative flexibility clients in Europe and play a key role in supporting Kraken's continued international growth. jobs.description: Four models in production today. Fifteen to twenty by mid-2027. The shared pipeline that gets them there has to hold — and you own everything after handoff: packaging, deployment, drift detection, and the call on whether a model is fit to serve. Location: Central Berlin — you work from our office, hybrid with 3 days office and 2 days home office.   About us CarOnSale is the AI-powered platform for B2B used car trading in Europe. Over 40,000 buyers from more than 20 countries trade on our platform — and 85% of inventory is exclusive to us. We connect software, pricing intelligence, logistics and financing in one layer — as the operating system for an entire industry. One Platform. Our business model sits at the intersection of energy, tech, and finance, which makes our accounting more complex and more interesting than a typical start-up ledger. You'll start hands-on with day-to-day accounting and keep the books clean as volumes grow. At the same time, you'll spot the manual steps in your work and get room to automate them. You'll also be part of our ERP rollout. This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to own their area, not just process it. jobs.title: Ingénieur Conception & Instrumentation - Équipements et bancs d’essais (H/F)
jobs.description: Ingénieur Conception & Instrumentation – Équipements et bancs d’essais (H/F) À propos de notre client Notre client est une TPE basée au nord de Lyon, spécialisée dans les énergies du sous-sol : pétrole, gaz, géothermie et stockage de CO2. Son activité repose entièrement sur la R&D : essais sur géomatériaux, géomécanique et développement d'équipements d'essais pour des clients internationaux. Son équipe pluridisciplinaire et multiculturelle développe des solutions technologiques innovantes au service de l'efficacité, de la protection de l'environnement et de la maîtrise des coûts. L'entreprise est certifiée ISO 9001 et toutes ses activités respectent sa démarche QHSE. Le poste Votre rôle : mettre au point de véritables méthodes d’essai. À partir d’un besoin de mesure (température, pression, déplacement, déformation, ultrasons…), vous concevez, instrumentez et validez des cellules d’essais haute température et haute pression. Vous commencez par fiabiliser une cellule existante : simplifier son montage et son démontage, puis la valider à plus haute température. Vous lancez ensuite les cellules suivantes. Vous travaillez avec l’équipe qui conçoit aujourd’hui les équipements, et avec le bureau d’études d’un fabricant partenaire qui réalise la conception détaillée et les plans de fabrication. Environ 70-80 % conception et développement, 20-30 % laboratoire. Rattachement à la direction des opérations. Ce que le poste n’est pas : ni dessinateur ou calculateur (le détail et les plans sont externalisés), ni management d’équipe. Vos missions Définir le besoin, le cahier des charges et le pré-dimensionnement fonctionnel de nouvelles cellules. Choisir les capteurs adaptés et les intégrer ; résoudre les enjeux d’étanchéité, de tenue en température et en pression. Consulter fournisseurs et sous-traitants, suivre la fabrication des pièces. Monter, instrumenter et tester vous-même vos équipements au laboratoire ; interpréter les mesures et améliorer. Améliorer l’ergonomie des équipe

jobs.title: Technisch Support Engineer
jobs.description: Bij DeWarmte maken we slimme en betaalbare warmtepompen waarmee we woningen van het gas af helpen. We ontwerpen onze producten zelf, assembleren ze in Utrecht en zorgen samen met onze installatiepartners dat ze bij steeds meer mensen thuis komen te staan. Steeds meer woningen worden verwarmd met onze warmtepompen. En dat betekent dat we ook steeds meer installaties moeten monitoren, klanten ondersteunen en technische problemen oplossen. Daarom zoeken we een Technical Support Engineer die ons support team komt versterken. Je helpt klanten en monteurs bij technische vragen, onderzoekt storingen en zorgt dat onze warmtepompen optimaal blijven functioneren. Tegelijkertijd kijk je verder dan het probleem van vandaag. Waarom ontstaat een storing? Hoe kunnen we die in de toekomst voorkomen? En hoe kunnen we onze support slimmer organiseren? Je lost dus niet alleen problemen op, maar helpt ons ook om onze producten en service steeds beter te maken. Wat ga je doen? jobs.description: ENSTA, établissement d’enseignement supérieur et de recherche sous tutelle du ministère des Armées, développe des activités de formation, de recherche et d’innovation dans les domaines de la défense et de la sécurité, des transports, de l'énergie, des activités maritimes, du numérique et de la santé. L’école, présente sur deux campus, à Paris-Saclay et à Brest, est membre de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris. Classée dans le Top 10 des meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France, elle a pour mission : la formation d’élèves ingénieurs civils et militaires, de cadres et docteurs pour les secteurs public et privé, la recherche et l’innovation de haut niveau en relation étroite avec l’industrie des grands secteurs de souveraineté au sein de 6 unités de formation et de recherche (UFR). Le/la titulaire du poste sera affecté au sein de l’Unité de Formation et de Recherche (UFR) Mécanique. L’UFR de Mécanique a pour mission d’assurer la formation en mécanique des élèves du cursus ingénieur d’ENSTA, des élèves de masters de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, et la formation par la recherche d’étudiants français et étrangers au niveau master et doctorat. L’Unité développe également des activités de recherche dans le domaine de la mécanique des matériaux et des structures, de la mécanique des fluides, des vibrations et de l’acoustique. Ces activités sont réalisées grâce à un important parc expérimental de haut niveau en mécanique des solides et des fluides, tant pour l’enseignement que la recherche. Sur le campus de Brest, l’UFR de Mécanique compte une cinquantaine d’enseignants chercheurs, une cinquantaine de doctorants/post-doctorants ainsi qu’une dizaine de personnels techniques (ingénieurs, techniciens). Les activités de recherche des membres de l’UFR de Mécanique du site de Brest sont menées au sein de l’Institut de Recherche Dupuy de Lôme (IRDL, CNRS UMR 6027, www.irdl.fr ). La personne recrutée travaillera en étroite collaboration avec les enseignants-chercheurs de l’ENSTA,

jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks
jobs.description: We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want. You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models. Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week. How it works Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another. Requirements 2+ years of professional software engineering Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code) Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++ Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing Regular use of an AI coding tool Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words At least 10 hours a week, starting now A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines) Nice to have Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure Experience building agent

jobs.description: We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want. You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models. Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week. How it works Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another. Berikut ini adalah Rekrutmen Bina BNI Kantor Wilayah 17. P T Bank Negara Indonesia (Persero), Tbk pada awalnya didirikan di Indonesia sebagai Bank sentral dengan nama “Bank Negara Indonesia” berdasarkan Peraturan Pemerintah Pengganti Undang-Undang No. 2 tahun 1946 tanggal 5 Juli 1946. Selanjutnya, berdasarkan Undang-Undang No. 17 tahun 1968, BNI ditetapkan menjadi “Bank Negara Indonesia 1946”, dan statusnya menjadi Bank Umum Milik Negara. Selanjutnya, peran BNI sebagai Bank yang diberi mandat untuk memperbaiki ekonomi rakyat dan berpartisipasi dalam pembangunan nasional dikukuhkan oleh UU No. 17 tahun 1968 tentang Bank Negara Indonesia 1946. Berdasarkan Peraturan Pemerintah No. 19 tahun 1992, tanggal 29 April 1992, telah dilakukan penyesuaian bentuk hukum BNI menjadi Perusahaan Perseroan Terbatas (Persero). Penyesuaian bentuk hukum menjadi Persero, dinyatakan dalam Akta No. 131, tanggal 31 Juli 1992, dibuat di hadapan Muhani Salim, S.H., yang telah diumumkan dalam Berita Negara Republik Indonesia No. 73 tanggal 11 September 1992 Tambahan No. 1A.
